coverage.why: Showlist Austin is a single hand-curated page (no pagination) that currently runs Thu 2026-09-24 through Tue 2026-12-22 — about 13 weeks. It has no listings past that date (nothing to read, not a stop point we chose), so it cannot cover our full 2026-09-24 to 2027-05-31 window by itself. Five of our 17 venues (Empire, The Parish, Brushy Street Commons, Summit, Vulcan Gas Company) have zero entries anywhere on the page — Showlist Austin appears not to track them at all (no per-venue landing page either); everything else uses the venue's own display name.

cityWide.note: The page is one continuous list of all upcoming shows citywide (not filterable by date range server-side); a client-side 'Filters' widget exists but a plain curl fetch returns the unfiltered full list, so a 'next 30 days' count would require counting rows by date client-side rather than the source exposing the count itself.

linkBehavior: Every show title links straight to the presenting venue's or promoter's own ticketing page — never a showlistaustin.com redirect and never visibly affiliate-tagged. Example: the Antone's Sept 24 show links to https://antonesnightclub.com/tm-event/chicago-bound-album-release-party/ (Antone's own Ticketmaster-powered event page). Domains seen: ticketmaster.com (88 of 345, via Emo's/Stubb's/Scoot Inn's own TM-hosted pages), acllive.com (72, ACL Live + 3TEN's own site), antonesnightclub.com (53), mohawkaustin.com (45), continentalclub.com (30), moodycenteratx.com (24), kingdomnightclub.com (17), moodyamphitheater.com (12), germaniaamp.com (4).
